replies.body:
Media- For live streamers.
Ref- For referees for the tourney.

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Yes. They are users who are involved with the tournament staff. 

Media - They will be recording and streaming the tournaments to cater for YouTube and Twitch audiences. 
Refs - Ensure all teams are playing fairly, and to assist with running events smoothly.
